relations.subject: MILMAN, Henry Hart
relations.evidence: Educated at Eton and from 1810 at Brasenose College, Oxford. B.A. 1814, M.A. 1816.

relations.subject: MILMAN, Henry Hart
relations.evidence: In 1821-31 Professor of Poetry at Oxford.

relations.subject: MILMAN, Henry Hart
relations.evidence: Studied Sanskrit from books in order to be able to discuss Indian poetry in his lectures, later he had H. H. Wilson as adviser.
